source.user_intent: Reduce the gap between crew mates and turn convergence into a system that survives handoff without repeated briefing or silent authority drift.
research_correspondence: A2A 1.0: client-side artifact version linkage is the client's responsibility; context continuity is not artifact freshness.
MCP 2026 filesystem work: optimistic concurrency is an explicit interoperability concern; FIELD does not claim MCP conformance.

before: Crew handoff preserved object/intent/moves/evidence/RETURN, but another worker could receive a semantically correct packet after the underlying repo bytes had changed and still see TURN_READY.
delta: Add optional execution.source_witness with GIT_BLOB path + exact Git blob revision.
Add --witness <repo-path> --json to the existing machine entrypoint.
FRESH resumes the pre-existing coordination state.
STALE or MISSING fails closed to SOURCE_REQUIRED and requires fresh SOURCE/HOLD.
The opaque crew context handle does not change with revision because freshness is not object identity.
No task store, crew dashboard, auto-router, queue, memory service or new authority source was added.

residue.operator_burden: Ordinary human language remains sufficient. Coding workers only add a source witness when a handoff may outlive the current worker/turn.
residue.next_experiment: Use source_witness on one real cross-thread/cross-agent edit and measure whether it prevents repeated briefing or stale-context repair.
residue.stop: Do not add leases, distributed locks, shared task state or agent registry unless a real handoff failure survives this witness guard.
